title: Technology Sector Update for 05/21/2018: ROP,CMCM,FEYE

Technology stocks were solidly higher in Monday trading, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding almost 1.0% in value while the Philadelphia semiconductor index was posting a more than 0.9% gain.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Roper Technologies ( ROP ) rose almost 2% on Monday after agreeing to buy financial software firm, Powerplan, for $1.1 billion. Roper is expecting the new acquisition will be immediately cash accretive while also delivering around $150 million in revenue and about $60 million in after-tax free tax flow during the first 12 months of ownership, excluding the impact of fair value accounting. It plans to fund the deal using its revolving credit facility and cash on hand.
In other sector news:
- Cheetah Mobile ( CMCM ) declined Monday after forecasting Q2 revenue trailing Wall Street expectations. The mobile internet company is projecting revenue in a range of RMB1.02 billion to RMB1.08 billion compared with analyst estimates expecting RMB1.14 billion. Excluding one-time items, it also posted non-GAAP net income of RMB0.48 per American depositary share, or about $0.08 per ADS, during the three months ended March 31, up from RMB0.81 per ADS profit during the same quarter last year and beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.03 per ADS. It generated RMB1.15 billion, or about $182.6 million, in revenue this year, down from RMB1.19 billion last year but also topping the RMB1.13 billion analyst mean.
- FireEye ( FEYE ) was down over 2% on Monday after the software firm launched a $525 million private placement of convertible notes due 2024. The notes will be convertible into cash or shares of FireEye's common stock at FireEye's discretion. The interest rate, initial conversion rate, repurchase or redemption rights and other terms of the notes will be determined when the upcoming transaction prices following negotiations between the company and the initial purchasers of the notes.
